Assignment policy

Frequency comes from completed BT lists in Attendance. The default is at least 3 eligible records, using the most recent 10 complete BT sessions per trap. Adjust thresholds and the window in Frequency rules.

Manual Frequently / Sometimes / Rarely / Unknown codes are the fallback until enough records exist. Whales marked “Fast” prefer row two. This is a seating preference, not proof of a faster rally cycle. Unknown attendance receives neutral priority.

Locked positions are preserved. Suggestions favour active players and avoid unnecessary moves between equivalent positions.
